## Rule
Verified over all 266 train+test+arc-gen pairs. Input F32 one-hot [1,10,30,30] (13×13
active) with several 3×3 objects; exactly one object holds a single marker cell of color
**8 at its center** (count-1, center — 0 violations). Output = that object's 3×3 patch with
**only the center (marker) cell recolored to object color k**; all other cells copied
verbatim. `output == patch-with-8→k` in every case. Padded to [1,10,30,30] top-left.

## Algorithm sketch (LIVE 327 graph)
Locate marker center via two marginal Einsums `bcrs,c,r->b` / `bcrs,c,s->b` with `chan8`
(one-hot@8) + `coord` (maps center→top-left, r0−1). Slice channel-0 3×3 → bg silhouette;
find first non-bg column in top row (offset 0/1/2 via bool gathers); slice that pixel's
10-ch one-hot → object color e_k; `Where(patch_bg, e0, e_k)` → small U8[1,10,3,3]; Pad→output.

## Cost analysis
327 = mem 259 + params 68. Forced: `small`(90, output one-hot) + `color_pixel`(40, F32
10-ch color read) + `bg_patch`(36, F32 silhouette read) + casts(19) + locator scalars(16);
params dominated by `coord`[30]+`chan8`[10] (memory-optimal marginal locator) + `e0`[10] +
`pads`[8]. Overhead beyond forced ≈ slice-index arrays + offset machinery (~55B). This is at
the floor — see `task121/hard_records/marker_einsum_crop_floor.md`. **WALL ≈ 310–326; the
prompt's ~150 floor is REFUTED** (it omits the forced color(40)+silhouette(36) reads that the
recolor requires).

## Don't-do log
- Do NOT drop a "[1,1,13,13] F32 marker plane" to reach 150 — LIVE has NO such plane; it uses
  a scalar marginal Einsum locator. That direction text is stale.
- Do NOT sample color from a fixed patch position — no non-center cell is always non-bg
  (bg in 115–134/266 per cell); fixed sampling ⇒ hidden 0. Dynamic non-bg find is forced.
- Do NOT read the full [1,10,3,3] patch to "avoid the 40B color pixel" — costs 90B F32 +
  90B U8 copy (formulation 2 = 769). LIVE bg(36)+color(40)=76 < 90.
- Do NOT use ArgMin/int marginals for the top-row offset — int32/int64 intermediates (28B)
  beat by LIVE's bool-gather chain (formulation 1 = 350).
- Padless output is DEAD (visible 0/266); Pad + 90B `small` are forced.
